removed.reason: Converting km/min to km/h is taught in this rates unit, so it is lesson content rather than prior knowledge.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}2.5\text{ km/min}&=\frac{2.5\text{ km}}{1\text{ min}}\\&=\frac{2.5\text{ km}}{\frac{1}{60}\text{ h}}\\&=2.5\times60\text{ km/h}\\&=150\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

content.prompt: The graph shows Emily's distance from home at one moment on her walk.

children.prompt: Write down the time and the distance from home at point $P$.

answer.worked:
Each grid square across is 10 minutes, so $P$ is at 9:50.
Each grid square up is 0.5 km, so $P$ is at 1.5 km.
